definitions.explanation: The activity of buying and selling goods or services for profit.
One's line of work, especially when it involves selling or providing services.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{小|ちい}さな{商売|しょうばい}をしている。
examples.english: My father runs a small business.

examples.japanese: {商売|しょうばい}は{順調|じゅんちょう}ですか。
お{客|きゃく}さんを{大切|たいせつ}にするのが{商売|しょうばい}の{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Taking good care of customers is the foundation of business.

notes:
{商売|しょうばい}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to do business."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商売|しょうばい}をする (to do business)
- {商売|しょうばい}が{繁盛|はんじょう}する (business is thriving)
- {商売|しょうばい}{敵|がたき} (business rival)
- {商売|しょうばい}{上手|じょうず} (skilled at business)
- {商売|しょうばい}{道具|どうぐ} (tools of the trade)

EXPRESSIONS:
- {商売|しょうばい}は{水物|みずもの} (Business is unpredictable)
